name: Bases Note Templates
changes: The Sponsor on GitHub button now opens the one-time payment tab of GitHub Sponsors.
tip: Let a filter value override the template's property so new notes match the view.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Bases Note Templates is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it with Bases. Bases is still new, and your setups teach me a lot.
